extraction.document_summary: Great Eastern “Prestige PACare” is a personal accident plan providing worldwide accident protection with 24/7 emergency assistance. The core benefit is Accidental Death & Permanent Disablement, with coverage of S$1 million to S$3.5 million (sum assured) for death or permanent disablement due to an accident, stated as “high 24/7 worldwide coverage of up to S$3.5 million.” An optional feature supplements the plan with Medical Expense Reimbursement up to S$20,000 for each accident, including Complementary Medicine Practitioner treatment up to S$500 and Mobility Aids up to S$1,000. The plan also provides emergency assistance services covering medical evacuation/repatriation and related assistance. Benefits are reduced by 50% for “high-risk activities,” and terrorism benefits are limited to S$2 million per life assured across this plan and all similar plans/riders. The policy is guaranteed renewable annually until age 75, with a 5% renewal discount from the 2nd policy year (regardless of claims).
quality_notes: Document states core benefit limits, renewal age, and renewal discount; does not state min entry age, policy term length, free-look days, grace period, or underwriting/medical-exam requirements.

Pricing table includes occupancy classes and a statement of 50% reduction for high-risk activities; some premium figures appear under “Optional Supplement” with dashes, suggesting the table is structured but not fully machine-readable for all fields.
Terrorism coverage limitation is explicitly quantified (S$2 million per life assured) and applies under this plan and all other similar plans/riders.

policies.quick_summary: Worldwide personal accident coverage with Accidental Death & Permanent Disablement (S$1M–S$3.5M) plus optional Medical Expense Reimbursement up to S$20,000 per accident (including up to S$500 complementary medicine and up to S$1,000 mobility aids) and emergency assistance services. Guaranteed renewable annually until age 75 with 5% renewal discount from 2nd year; benefits reduced by 50% for high-risk activities; terrorism capped at S$2M per life assured across similar plans/riders and this plan/its riders/supplements provide similar benefits coverage scope per document limit statement. Worldwide coverage and 24/7 Alarm Centre assistance stated.
policies.target_customer: Singapore Citizen/Permanent Resident (brochure applies mainly to Singapore Citizen/Permanent Resident)
coverage_scope: Worldwide emergency assistance via 24-hour Alarm Centre
Worldwide protection against terrorism (subject to benefit limit)
policies.residency_requirements: Brochure applies mainly to Singapore Citizen/Permanent Resident; if not a Singapore Citizen/Permanent Resident, you have to meet certain residency requirements before you can apply or renew.
occupation_classes: Class 1: professional/managerial/administrative/clerical and non-manual occupations in general
Class 2: supervisory and others not in Class 1 (no use of tools and machinery or special hazards); includes substantial travelling (e.g. salesmen)
Class 3: manual work not of particularly hazardous nature but involving the use of tools and machinery
policies.eligibility_notes: Only the above occupational classes are allowed for Prestige PA Care; exact occupational class determined by the company. All ages specified refer to age next birthday.
policies.coverage_term_description: Renew your plan annually until age 75 (guaranteed renewability stated).
policies.renewal_basis: Renew annually until age 75; 5% renewal discount on premium starting from 2nd policy year regardless of any claims made under the plan.
important_caveats: For high-risk activities, the company will reduce all benefits payable by 50%.
Terrorism protection is subject to a benefit limit of S$2 million per life assured under this plan and all other plans or riders providing similar benefits on terrorism.
Premium rates are not guaranteed and may be adjusted at policy renewal with at least 30 days’ notice.

review_notes: The brochure contains an optional feature label for medical expenses (“Option to supplement with additional coverage”) and presents an “Emergency Assistance Service” line in the benefits table; however, the document does not explicitly label “Emergency Assistance Service” as optional in prose, only the medical reimbursement is clearly described as an optional supplement. Emergency assistance is therefore captured as optional per table context but should be confirmed in the policy contract.

The product is described as guaranteed renewable annually until age 75 and as applying mainly to Singapore Citizen/Permanent Resident; minimum entry age, underwriting basis, free-look period days, and grace period are not stated in the provided document.
